security_audit.summary: The script makes expected network requests to BrowserAct and reads one declared BrowserAct API key. Most command and reconnaissance alerts are scanner noise, but the skill asks users to provide an API key in chat.

remediation.suggestion: Require users to set BROWSERACT_API_KEY locally and remove instructions that ask users to paste the key into a conversation.
Document that keywords, task ids, results, and authorization headers are sent to BrowserAct before users run the skill.
Keep the Python command fixed, quote user arguments, and document that the local script performs BrowserAct API requests only.

content.user_title: Extract YouTube Channel Data with BrowserAct
content.value_statement: Finding relevant YouTube channels by hand is slow and inconsistent. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow that returns structured channel data from keyword searches.
actual_capabilities: Runs a local Python helper that submits a BrowserAct workflow template.
Searches YouTube channels by keyword and optional upload date filter.
Polls BrowserAct task status until completion or timeout.
Returns channel names, links, handles, subscriber counts, descriptions, thumbnails, and verification status.
Reports invalid authorization and task failures with retry guidance.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct API key before any request can run.
Sends keywords and task data to BrowserAct's hosted API.
Depends on BrowserAct workflow availability and YouTube search behavior.
Does not validate channel data against a second source.

use_cases.description: Find channels for a target topic and compare basic profile data for market research.

use_cases.title: Build Partnership Lists
use_cases.description: Collect channel links, handles, descriptions, and subscriber counts for creator outreach planning.

use_cases.title: Monitor Competitor Topics
use_cases.description: Search recurring keywords to identify channels discussing products, brands, or industry themes.

prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for a single topic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find YouTube channels about AI automation. Use any upload date.

prompt_templates.scenario: Use an upload date filter for fresher channel activity.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find YouTube channels about sustainable travel that uploaded this week. Summarize channel names, handles, and subscriber counts.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Outreach Shortlist
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare creator research for a campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a shortlist of YouTube channels about B2B cybersecurity for partnership outreach. Include links, descriptions, and verification status.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Related Niches
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced research across multiple keyword groups.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run searches for project management software and remote team tools. Compare notable channels by topic, subscriber range, and recent activity.

output_examples.output: A channel discovery list with names, links, handles, subscriber counts, verification status, descriptions, and thumbnails.

output_examples.input: Find channels about vegan recipes that uploaded this week.
output_examples.output: A recent creator shortlist showing channel identity, visible audience size, profile summary, and source links.

output_examples.input: Compare channels for two competitor keywords.
output_examples.output: A comparison summary that groups returned channels by keyword and highlights useful outreach or monitoring candidates.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the environment instead of pasting secrets into chat.
Use narrow keywords and upload date filters for cleaner results.
Review returned channel data before importing it into outreach or CRM tools.
anti_patterns: Do not ask users to paste API keys into shared conversations.
Do not run broad searches when a specific market or niche is required.
Do not treat subscriber counts as verified business metrics without review.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY so the local script can call the BrowserAct workflow API.

faq.question: What data can it return?
faq.answer: It can return channel names, links, handles, subscriber counts, descriptions, thumbnails, and verification status when available.

faq.question: Does it scrape YouTube directly from my machine?
faq.answer: No. The local script sends a workflow request to BrowserAct and receives the workflow output.

faq.question: Can I filter by recent uploads?
faq.answer: Yes. The script accepts an upload date value, such as This week or Any time.

faq.question: Is the returned data always complete?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on BrowserAct, YouTube search behavior, and the fields available for each channel.

faq.question: How should I handle credentials safely?
faq.answer: Set the API key as an environment variable. Avoid pasting reusable secrets into conversations or shared logs.
